english.title: Wilful / unlawfully obstruct / interfere with manoeuvres within a manoeuvres area and during a manoeuvres period
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully and unlawfully obstructed or interfered with the execution of manoeuvres within a manoeuvres area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), during a manoeuvres period, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(1)(a) of the Manoeuvres Act 1958.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
within a Manoeuvres area and during a Manoeuvres period
wilfully and unlawfully obstructed or interfered with the execution of the Manoeuvres

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) The defendant and any animal, vehicle or other property under his charge may be removed by any constable, or by, or by order of, any commissioned officer of the armed forces - section 8(1).
